records.name: Promina Gleichsoweit
records.biography_en: Has rehearsed the entrance and forgotten what happens after being seen. Her matching HyperNorm corsages promise an evening that will make the private self publicly acceptable. A dissonant card asks what she would enjoy if nobody were watching. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Auftritt ist geprobt. Das Danach bleibt offen.

variant_notes.note_en: Has rehearsed the entrance and forgotten what happens after being seen.

records.name: Azubi Erstgleich
records.biography_en: Would like the first instruction to explain which questions are allowed. His HyperNorm badge grants entry before he understands the role. A dissonant card asks an ordinary question that the induction pack has somehow omitted. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die erste Rückfrage wartet auf ihre Zulässigkeit.

variant_notes.note_en: Would like the first instruction to explain which questions are allowed.

records.name: Spindboss Platzda
records.biography_en: Guards a little territory because everything beyond it feels uncertain. His little HyperNorm locker door marks the edge of a territory he can control. A dissonant card stays nearby without agreeing that fear is authority. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Platz ist gesichert. Der Rest erscheint weiterhin unsicher.

variant_notes.note_en: Guards a little territory because everything beyond it feels uncertain.

records.name: Tagebuchfrau Innenleben
records.biography_en: Keeps the private version safe from the version everybody expects. Her HyperNorm diary keeps the unapproved version of an otherwise satisfactory day. A dissonant card offers company without requesting the key. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die private Fassung bleibt vorerst ordnungsgemäß verschlossen.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps the private version safe from the version everybody expects.

records.name: Absolvent Vielleichtfrei
records.biography_en: Has completed the required beginning and is waiting for a useful next instruction. His HyperNorm diploma confirms that he has completed the authorized beginning. A dissonant card asks whether freedom needs a next instruction. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Abschluss berechtigt zur Suche nach dem nächsten Anfang.

variant_notes.note_en: Has completed the required beginning and is waiting for a useful next instruction.

records.name: Prüfling Bremsbereit
records.biography_en: Can remember every rule until somebody watches him remember it. His HyperNorm steering wheel turns easily until an examiner watches. A dissonant card reminds him that being observed is not the same as being understood. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Regeln sind bekannt, solange niemand ihr Erinnern prüft.

variant_notes.note_en: Can remember every rule until somebody watches him remember it.
